---
title: "Election Results Atlas"
---

The atlas compares election results at the geographic level available for
each state. It starts with North Carolina, where the State Board of Elections
publishes precinct-level November results.

## Available states

- [North Carolina](north-carolina.qmd): November 2026 county and precinct results

The North Carolina page begins with a county map and includes the same
precinct-level source data used by the statewide analysis.
